newsitem.title: USA: UnionBancal says tax refunds approved.
newsitem.headline: UnionBancal says tax refunds approved.

text.p: UnionBancal Corp said Thursday that, subject to finalization of a formal agreement with the Franchise Tax Board of the State of California, the Franchise Tax Board has approved tax and interest refunds to settle litigation, administration and audit disputes covering tax years 1975-1987.
The final agreement, the company said, is expected to be signed during the third quarter 1997.
It is estimated that the effect on the corporation's net income would be about $25 million after tax, the company said.
Based on about 54.8 million shares outstanding at June 30, 1997, this would be about $0.42 per common share, the company said.
Based in San Francisco, UnionBanCal Corporation is a bank holding company with assets of $30.3 billion.
